name: openplay-storage-review-9da55965-da1d-48f2-a1ed-6ef0c57d6b58

checks.name: Commit original bytes and catalog metadata atomically
List returns metadata without eagerly copying all audio blobs
Close/reopen reconstructs File with exact original bytes and attributes
Duplicate content updates one stable entry instead of adding a second
False content identity is rejected before either object store changes
Uncloneable metadata aborts the real transaction without replacing original audio
Injected quota error after catalog request rolls back real transaction
Corrupted stored bytes fail their hash instead of silently decoding wrong media

evidence.error: Saved audio failed its identity check. Re-import the original file.

checks.name: Missing media record is explicit while catalog identity remains recoverable
Reimport repairs missing audio under the same stable content identity
Concurrent distinct imports commit two catalog/media pairs
Close while hashing prevents a late save and refuses subsequent operations
Unavailable storage rejects explicitly rather than claiming a saved file

scope: Actual browser IndexedDB transactions, structured Blob/File storage, close/reopen and integrity reads on owned synthetic fixtures. Quota failure uses an injected throw inside a real transaction; no real disk exhaustion. No main UI/native restart/audio/device/reference acceptance.
